mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression codec

No decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded for this project, so no codec is specified here. This document will state one once a decision is recorded.

cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no transport compression codec decision is currently recorded, and it names no codec.

Muninn's only decision on record (#6) is about caching, "LRU with 300-second TTL". The compression-related entries I found are bare "gzip" and "zstd" messages from separate sessions. Each is a one-word message with no task attached, at trust 1, and they disagree, so I didn't treat either as a decision. `muninn why` also came back "insufficient" for this question.

The first `Bash` attempt to write the file failed with a parser error and wrote nothing. I then created the file with the Write tool.
